description: Defines internal attributes and enums related to code analysis, specifically the DynamicallyAccessedMembersAttribute and DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes enum, used for indicating dynamic member access in .NET code.

classes.name: DynamicallyAccessedMembersAttribute
